fields.intervention: Retune ECM idle air control (IAC) valve opening map and fuel trim parameters specifically for the cold start/long park transient to ensure sufficient oxygen-to-fuel ratio for rapid catalytic converter heating without rich mixture misfires
fields.expected_effect: Elimination of intermittent low-idle misfires, stable idle without stalling, and clear check engine light during cold starts after long park
fields.falsification_test: Cold start engine after 24h park, monitor O2 sensor switching activity and IAC valve duty cycle; verify no misfire codes (P0300-P0399) logged within first 60 seconds and stable idle RPM

fields.mechanism: Cold-fast-idle control strategy optimizing air-fuel ratio and ignition timing during the cold start period to stabilize combustion, reduce hydrocarbon emissions, and achieve fast catalyst light-off.
fields.intervention: Reprogram the engine control unit to implement a cold-fast-idle control algorithm that commands elevated idle speed via the idle air control valve, enriches the air-fuel mixture, and advances ignition timing specifically during the first 60 seconds after a long park cold start on the 2.0L i-VTEC engine.
fields.expected_effect: Combustion stability is maintained at low idle during cold starts and after long park events, eliminating intermittent misfires, preventing stalling at stops, and keeping the check engine light off.
fields.falsification_test: Perform a controlled cold soak of the vehicle for 12 hours at ambient temperature below 10 degrees Celsius, start the engine, and monitor cylinder-specific misfire counters and short-term fuel trims via OBD-II datalogging for the first 120 seconds; if any cylinder registers more than zero misfires or fuel trim exceeds plus or minus 5 percent, the intervention fails.
fields.mechanism_source_span: SI Engine Control in the Cold-Fast-Idle Period for Low HC Emissions and Fast Catalyst Light Off
